source: ZXNAME0000XZ and ZXNAME0001XZ designs emphasize different kinds of progress. A ZXNAME0002XZ invests heavily in making a relatively small set of instruction streams advance quickly. A ZXNAME0003XZ accepts lower per-thread performance so it can keep a much larger population of threads in flight and deliver high aggregate throughput.[1,2]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 和 ZXNAME0001XZ 设计强调不同类型的进步。 ZXNAME0002XZ 投入了大量资金来使相对较小的指令流集快速前进。 ZXNAME0003XZ 接受较低的每线程性能，因此它可以保持更多的线程处于运行状态并提供高聚合吞吐量。[1,2]
